Load or save all datasets from a multi-member SAS XPORT v8/v9 file

Source: R/read_single_xpt.r
ks_batch_load_from_single_xpt.Rd

Iterates all members found by ks_xpt_content and either assigns them into .GlobalEnv or writes them to disk.

Usage

ks_batch_load_from_single_xpt(
  file,
  action = "load",
  save_type = NULL,
  save_path = NULL
)

Arguments

file

Path to the XPORT file.

action

"load" (assign to .GlobalEnv) or "save" (write to disk).

save_type

For action = "save": one of "rdata", "rds", or "parquet".

save_path

For action = "save":

  • "rdata": path without extension (appended automatically).

  • "rds" / "parquet": path to an existing directory.

Value

Invisibly returns a named list of all extracted datasets.

Details

action = "load"

Each dataset is assigned into .GlobalEnv using its lower-case member name.

action = "save", save_type = "rdata"

All datasets are saved together into a single .RData file at save_path (the .RData extension is appended automatically). The global environment is not modified.

action = "save", save_type = "rds"

Each dataset is saved as a separate .rds file inside the save_path directory.

action = "save", save_type = "parquet"

Each dataset is saved as a separate Parquet file (requires the arrow package).

Members are extracted in parallel on non-Windows platforms (mclapply); lapply is used on Windows.

See also

ks_xpt_content, ks_extract_single_xpt

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Load all members into .GlobalEnv
ks_batch_load_from_single_xpt("study.xpt", action = "load")

## Save each member as .rds
ks_batch_load_from_single_xpt("study.xpt",
                               action    = "save",
                               save_type = "rds",
                               save_path = "data/")
} # }
